summary: Native cross-platform desktop installers and GitHub Releases packaging.

changes.title: Native desktop release
changes.detail: Ronic OS now ships as a native Windows installer, macOS DMG, and Linux packages from GitHub Releases.

changes.title: Reliable local backend
changes.detail: The Rust backend stays embedded in the desktop binary and uses loopback-only services instead of a Node or browser server.

changes.title: Windows installation
changes.detail: The Windows setup creates a Start Menu entry and desktop shortcut, and includes the WebView2 offline installer for restricted networks.
